tool.name: Pydantic AI
tool.description: Type-safe Python agent framework from the Pydantic team with model-agnostic providers and durable execution integrations.
strengths: Typed tools, deps and structured outputs
tool.practitionerNote: Good fit for Python teams that want typed, testable agent code and to swap model providers by string; pair with Temporal or DBOS for long-running work. v1 still gets security patches (v1.107.7 alongside v2.52.0), so pin a major version deliberately.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted library; operator controls placement and model provider (Logfire cloud is optional and separate).

deployment.detail: OSS library run in the operator's own process; no hosted control plane required.

auditLogging.detail: No built-in audit log; OpenTelemetry instrumentation (optionally to Logfire) must be wired up by the operator.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted library; SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted library; ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted library; ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Developer component, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.
